description: On-device SMS parsing (consumed by android/core). Amounts in paise. merchant: VPA handle before '@', else text after trf to/towards/at/to/for/on (debit) or from/by (credit) up to ' on ', 'Ref', 'UPI', '. ', 'Avl', newline or end; 'Unknown' if none. Messages that are OTPs, promotions (no debit/credit verb or no account/card/UPI mention), failures, collect requests or future mandates parse to null.
